children: Cyberloq Technologies entered into amended, restated, and consolidated promissory notes with all holders of its convertible notes to streamline its capital structure. The notes bear no ordinary interest from Sep 1, 2026 through Sep 1, 2028 and mature on Sep 1, 2028, with 12% default interest thereafter if unpaid. Accrued and unpaid interest through Aug 31, 2026 will convert into common shares at $0.10 per share, after which prior conversion rights are terminated. Upon issuance of these shares, Cyberloq expects to have no outstanding convertible debt.
: Amended, restated, and consolidated promissory notes (convertible notes restructuring)
: Simplify debt and eliminate conversion features
